props.text: What teams ask before they bring us in.
Straight answers about how our specialists work alongside your AI agents, from the first brief to the work you ship.

props.question: How does Humanify work with the AI agents we already run?
props.answer: Your agents keep generating. Our specialists step in where judgment matters: setting the brief, choosing between options, editing for tone and accuracy, and shaping the result into something your audience trusts. You keep your tools, your pipelines, and your pace.

props.question: Which kinds of work do you take on?
props.answer: Creative direction, product storytelling, brand and voice systems, campaign concepts, insight synthesis, and executive communication. If your agents can draft it, we can make it genuinely excellent.

props.question: Do you replace our team or our agents?
props.answer: Neither. We add the human layer: the taste, context, and accountability that turn capable output into standout work. Your people stay in charge, and your agents stay busy.
